result_text:
`all_files.zip` now packages the scope file lists under the names they were written under, so a renamed aspect no longer breaks the export.

**Change:** in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, the hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` entries are replaced by calls to a new private helper, `getAspectTextEntry(aspect)`. The helper names the entry with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same function that writes the loose files, and reads that file from the text folder. Entries stay in the order main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

**Verification:** the reports module compiles offline. `mvn -o -pl reports test -Dtest=DataExporter` ran no tests, because no test class covers `DataExporter`. I did not run an end-to-end export with a renamed aspect, so the renamed case is verified by reading the code, not by a run.

I did not commit.
